name: Estes Alpha III
description: Published 307 mm length and 25 mm body diameter; simplified nose and fins.

geometryEvidence.summary: Published 307 mm length and 25 mm body diameter; simplified nose and fins.
geometryEvidence.limitations: External airframe reference for educational model rockets: open tube, hollow nose and separate fins. Z is the longitudinal axis. No motor mount, motor, igniter, propellant or deployment mechanism. Published product dimensions are rounded; tube wall, nose profile/length and fin shapes are editable assumptions, not traced factory parts. The nose sits at the tube end without a modeled retention joint. These are layout solids, not flight-ready kits.
